svg.text: Heavy arrows are region hand-offs; the cyan one is the HTTP response. Light arrows are steps inside a region. Frontend review is drawn as UI work, never as backend validation.
Extraction only. This endpoint writes nothing to MongoDB, keeps no file and returns values that exist solely to prefill a form.
